title: Python Programming
description: Python mastery from basic syntax to advanced OOP, functional programming, memory models, and algorithmic problem solving.
outcomes: Master fundamental to advanced concepts in Python Programming.
Build industry-standard applications and capstone projects.
Excel in technical interviews and competitive programming.

modules.title: Python Foundations & Execution Model
modules.description: CPython interpreter, interactive shell, variables, dynamic typing, PEP 8 style guide, and basic syntax.

modules.title: Input, Output & String Formatting
modules.description: print(), input(), format specifiers, str.format(), and modern f-strings.

modules.title: Control Flow: Conditionals
modules.description: if, elif, else statements, nested conditionals, ternary expressions, and truthiness.

modules.title: Control Flow: Loops & Iterations
modules.description: while loops, for loops, range(), enumerate(), zip(), break, continue, and loop else clauses.

modules.title: Functions, Scopes & Lambda Expressions
modules.description: Function definitions, *args, **kwargs, default parameters, variable scope (LEGB rule), closures, and anonymous lambda functions.

modules.title: Strings & Regular Expressions
modules.description: String slicing, indexing, string methods (split, join, strip, replace), and re module pattern matching.

modules.title: Object-Oriented Programming: Classes & Objects
modules.description: Classes, instances, __init__, self, instance vs class attributes, class methods, static methods, and data encapsulation.

modules.title: Advanced OOP: Inheritance & Dunder Methods
modules.description: Single/multiple inheritance, super(), Method Resolution Order (MRO), polymorphism, and special dunder methods (__str__, __repr__, __len__, __getitem__).

modules.title: Exception Handling & Context Managers
modules.description: try, except, else, finally, custom exceptions, with statement, and context managers.

modules.title: File Handling & Modules
modules.description: Reading/writing text and binary files, CSV handling, json module, import mechanics, packages, and virtual environments.

modules.title: Algorithmic Problem Solving & Projects
modules.description: Coding challenges, algorithmic patterns, web scraping script, command-line utilities, and capstone software applications.
